isomorphisms.name: Product Form to Multiplicative Integral
isomorphisms.chi_law: chi(W) = C_W[∭∏ i dx dy dt]
isomorphisms.physics_process: Multiplicative integral of a set of functions over a volume; if any factor function is zero on a set of positive measure, the integral is zero.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Structural veto: any factor (Grace, Motion, etc.) going to zero annihilates coherence.
isomorphisms.prediction: If any factor is zero, chi = 0.
physics_process_steps: Define functions f_i(x,y,t) for each factor.
If any f_i = 0 on a set of positive measure, integral = 0.
mapped_text_steps: Define variables G, M, E, S, T, K, R, Q, F.
Structural veto: any factor zero kills chi.
preserved_transitions: Integral over domain → integral over spacetime
missing_transitions: C_W wrapper has no direct physics analog in a simple multiplicative integral.
isomorphisms.notes: The mapping is nearly perfect. The C_W wrapper is an extra operation not present in a bare multiplicative integral, but it is a functional wrapper, not a factor, so the core veto structure is preserved.

isomorphisms.name: Ratio Form to Signal-to-Noise Ratio
isomorphisms.physics_process: SNR = signal_power / noise_power; threshold at 1 determines detectability.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Combat between order and disorder; chi > 1 means order dominates, chi < 1 means entropy wins.
isomorphisms.prediction: When chi < 1, system is dominated by disorder.
missing_transitions: Numerator and denominator are not simple powers; they are products of distinct variables.
T^{-1}_debt is not a standard noise term.
isomorphisms.notes: The ratio form is structurally analogous to SNR, but the specific composition of numerator and denominator is not standard. The mapping is suggestive but not one-to-one at the level of individual terms.

isomorphisms.domain_b: Open system thermodynamics: dU/dt = Q_dot - W_dot + mu dN
isomorphisms.physics_process: First law for open system: rate of change of internal energy = heat input - work output + chemical potential flow.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: BC2 quantified: coherence changes due to Grace input, entropy production, and free will coupling.
physics_process_steps: Closed system: dU/dt = 0 if no internal sources.
mapped_text_steps: Measure Grace input, entropy production, coupling.
missing_transitions: Gamma(W) is not a standard thermodynamic term; it is a coupling term dependent on free will.
S is not standard entropy production; it includes moral dimension.
isomorphisms.notes: The dynamic form maps well to open system thermodynamics, but the Gamma(W) term and the moral interpretation of S are non-standard. The mapping is structurally sound but requires theological interpretation.
